statement: A joiner that is honestly waiting inside the operation-ledger formation barrier tells the operator so on the live log: the joining owner (NodeJoiningOperationLedgerFormationReadiness) emits a typed still-waiting line (JOINING_LOG_MSG.PRIORITY_PLACEMENT_FORMATION_BARRIER_STILL_WAITING) on every EXISTING liveness-refresh tick while the barrier is engaged, naming the owner's own barrier state and startup-authority answer plus elapsed ms since the wait began, and a typed evidence-advance line at debug level rate-limited to one per liveness-refresh window when the gate's evidence changed but the gate is still unsatisfied. The lines are a projection of the owner's existing barrier snapshot: no new timer, sleep, or polling acceleration, no second readiness authority, nothing re-derived from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage, JOINING_DEFAULT cadences and the 60-second GCP certification window byte-identical, and the READY instant proven identical with and without the lines. Proven deterministically through the real awaitOperationLedgerFormationBarrier on a virtual clock (30-second honest wait): red on HEAD (no line during the wait), green after.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The joining owner (NodeJoiningOperationLedgerFormationReadiness) remains the single emitter; the lines are a projection of its existing barrier snapshot and introduce no second readiness authority.
The wait reason is the owner's own barrier state and the readiness owner's startup-authority answer it already holds; nothing is re-derived from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage.
The still-waiting line rides only the existing liveness-refresh tick and the evidence-advance line only the existing poll; no timer, sleep, or polling acceleration is added.
JOINING_DEFAULT discovery/poll/timeout/heartbeat and the 60-second GCP certification window are byte-identical, and the READY instant is identical with and without the lines.
Proof is a virtual-clock witness through the real owner, red on HEAD (2/7 receipts red) and green after (7/7), with green controls that must stay green; no GCP run is part of the proof.
